g.text: 1. Contemporaneous — at the time (late entry marked + reasoned, never back-timed)
2. Factual — seen/heard/measured; quote speech; no \"rude/difficult\" labels
3. Complete — assessment, decision, consent, advice, refusal, escalation, handover
4. Timed + dated + signed — name + PIN + cadre, every entry
5. Legible + permanent ink — no blanks (line through), no gaps between entries
6. Unaltered — single line + initial + date errors; NEVER Tipp-Ex/overwrite/delete
7. Countersigned — students' entries checked + co-signed by supervisor
8. Confidential — filed, locked, logged; access = care role only (Module 04)

svg.text: FORMATS (pick the ward's, use it fully)
E-records: own password (never shared — entries are SIGNED by login), log off
every exit, copy-paste FORBIDDEN (stale data kills — re-assess, re-enter), templates
completed not clicked-through, downtime paper per protocol. Abbreviations: ward
list only — banned: U (units), IU, trailing zeros (5.0), naked decimals (.5), QD/QOD,
drug-name shortenings. \"Not documented, not done\" rules courts, tribunals AND
handovers — the unwritten allergy, refusal, fall or escalation is indefensible.
Retention: per policy/years (minors to adulthood + years, maternity long) — never
destroy early, never take home. Audit your own notes monthly: would the panel
reading aloud embarrass or exonerate you? Write for exoneration.
